data.description: Discover Opulence, Entertainment, and Sophistication at Al Habtoor City.

data.answer:
Residents of Al Habtoor City enjoy tranquil waterfront living near impressive restaurants, upscale boutiques, and cozy cafes. The community also offers residents and visitors an exciting nightlife experience, thanks to its many clubs and bars.

The area is popular for hosting La Perle by Dragone, a stunning award-winning live show featuring aquatic acrobatics and a talented cast. Al Habtoor City La Perle is truly a unique live performance experience.

Al Habtoor City Dubai has a residential complex called Residence Collection. It includes two 75-story towers and one 52-story skyscraper. The complex consists of over 1,000 apartment units and some penthouses as well. Named Noora, Amna, and Meera, these residential blocks showcase contemporary 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom units alongside exclusive penthouses.

Various penthouse options within Al Habtoor City are available. These include 3 simplexes, 6 duplexes, and 3 VIP units. The 4-story VIP penthouses consist of 7 bedrooms, along with pools, Jacuzzis, and steam rooms, these units boast garden terraces. The top two floors host a private entertainment area and sky lounge with an exclusive entrance reserved for residents.

Upcoming Projects and Expansions in Al Habtoor City

The forthcoming off-plan project, Al Habtoor Tower is located on Sheikh Zayed Road. The Al Habtoor Tower features 82 floors with 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments. Developed by Al Habtoor Group, this project will include infinity pools, a lavish spa, a library, and an amenity deck

Properties for Rent in Al Habtoor City

For those in search of rental apartments Al Habtoor City, here's an overview of the price ranges:

  • 1-bedroom flats for rent in Al Habtoor City are available for minimum AED 109k.
  • Rent for 2-bedroom flats in Al Habtoor City will be at least AED 140k per year.
  • 3-bedroom apartments for rent in Al Habtoor City begin from AED 234k.

Additionally, penthouses in the area are also available for rent. The average annual rent for 4-bedroom townhouses in Al Habtoor City is about AED 395k.

Properties for Sale in Al Habtoor City Location

There are many properties for sale in Al Habtoor City Dubai. These include 1,2, and 3-bedroom apartments, the starting prices of which are given below:

  • 1-bedroom apartments for sale in Al Habtoor City start from AED 1.53M.
  • The minimum purchase price of a 2-bedroom apartment in Al Habtoor City is AED 2.2M minimum.
  • For a 3-bedroom apartment in Al Habtoor City, you have to pay at least AED 3.2M.

These units feature spacious and stylishly designed interiors, each equipped with a private balcony and floor-to-ceiling windows. In addition, there are a limited number of Al Habtoor City penthouses available for sale, ranging from three to seven bedrooms.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Dubai Al Habtoor City?

data.answer:
Residents of Al Habtoor City enjoy a vibrant lifestyle surrounded by modern amenities and stunning waterfront views. The residential options in the community ranging from stylish apartments to lavish penthouses. World-class hotels, fine dining restaurants, and trendy cafes offer endless culinary experiences, while leisure facilities such as infinity pools, spas, and fitness centres cater to wellness and relaxation needs. These features make Al Habtoor City Dubai one of the most sought-after destinations for urban living in the city.

Public Transportation in Al Habtoor City Dubai

Al Habtoor City in Dubai offers its residents excellent connectivity through various public transportation options. The Dubai Metro's Red Line serves the community, with the Business Bay Metro Station located nearby, providing convenient access to the major areas and landmarks.

Those opting for the bus can find one at the Safa Intersection, Al Quoz Municipality Centre, or Lillian Tower bus stops, all accessible within a 10-minute walk. Also, you can easily find taxi and car-hailing services in the area.

Supermarkets in Al Habtoor City

Near Al Habtoor City, you'll find several supermarkets conveniently located. Nestled within the vibrant surroundings of Al Habtoor City, the All-day Fresh Supermarket is a haven for those seeking quality products and convenience all under one roof. Boasting a wide selection of fresh produce, groceries, household essentials, and gourmet delights, it ensures that shoppers can find everything they need for their daily requirements and special occasions.

Beach City Supermarket is located about 5 minutes away from the community on Jumeirah Beach Road. It is a one-stop shop for all kinds of groceries and other essentials.

West Hill Supermarket is about 16 minutes away from Al Habtoor City. From friendly service to a carefully curated selection of products, this neighborhood gem is a reliable destination for all your grocery needs.

Shopping in Al Habtoor City

Whether you're seeking upscale boutiques, trendy fashion outlets, or everyday essentials, Al Habtoor City caters to various preferences and needs. Additionally, the proximity to prominent shopping destinations such as The Dubai Mall in Downtown Dubai and City Walk further enhances the shopping opportunities for those residing in or visiting the area.

Schools Near Al Habtoor City

Several pre-schools and nurseries are close to Al Habtoor City. The nearby nurseries include Maple Bear, Blossom Nursery, and Odyssey Nursery. Blossom Nursery's nearest branch to Al Habtoor City is located in the Al Manzil District of Downtown Dubai. It follows the Early Years Foundation Stage (EYFS) curriculum and is within a 13-minute car ride.

Maple Bear follows the Canadian curriculum, while Odyssey Nursery adheres to the Washington State Early Learning Developmental Benchmarks. Nearby schools include GEMS Jumeirah Primary School and Al Ittihad Private School, which are reachable within 9 minutes by car and offer American and UK curriculums.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques Near Al Habtoor City Area 

Al Habtoor City in Business Bay houses a prayer hall, while Khalifa Bin Da’en Mosque is just a 9-minute drive away from the location. Regarding churches and temples near Al Habtoor City, options are limited within Business Bay. Emirates Baptist Church is approximately 17 minutes away in Al Barsha, while temples in Bur Dubai can be reached within a 13-minute drive.

Clinics and Hospitals in Al Habtoor City Sheikh Zayed Road Dubai

Several medical facilities are nearby, including Emirates Hospital, Medcare Hospital, and American Hospital Dubai, all of which can be reached by car within 10 to 12 minutes.

Al Habtoor City Location & Nearby Areas

Located on Sheikh Zayed Road along the Dubai Water Canal, Al Habtoor City provides convenient proximity to prominent landmarks and attractions in Dubai, such as Downtown Dubai, Dubai International Airport, and Dubai Marina.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Al Habtoor UAE

data.answer:
In Al Habtoor City, Dubai, there's no shortage of activities to keep residents and visitors entertained. Start your day with a stroll along the picturesque Dubai Water Canal promenade, offering breathtaking views and serene surroundings. Indulge in culinary delights at the diverse range of restaurants and cafes.

For a dose of culture and entertainment, catch a show at the renowned Dubai Opera or explore the vibrant nightlife scene nearby. Pamper yourself with a relaxing spa day or enjoy a workout session at state-of-the-art fitness centers within the community. You can also visit the amazing Al Habtoor City La Perle. With its prime location and array of leisure options, Al Habtoor City ensures an enriching and fulfilling experience for all.

Restaurants near Al Habtoor City Dubai

Nestled among the hotels and resorts, The Atrium in Al Habtoor City is a hub for various bars and restaurants. These include The Rose and Clown, a British pub offering classic English fare and beverages. Blind Dragon is also located at the venue offering a trendy ambiance and Asian-inspired cocktails.

Sirali Dubai is another upscale dining restaurant located near the area, featuring contemporary cuisine. Italian food lovers can visit Il Pastaio. It is trattoria-style restaurant serving authentic Italian pasta dishes.

In addition to The Atrium, nearby AL Habtoor City restaurants include the South African steakhouse City Grill and The Café at Hilton Dubai.

Beaches Near Akoya Al Habtoor City Location

For beach enthusiasts, while Al Habtoor City itself is surrounded by bustling roads, theme parks, and malls, nearby communities like Dubai Marina and Jumeirah offer access to beautiful beaches. Jumeirah Beach, a top favorite, is a mere 7-minute drive away, while Sunset Beach and other public beaches in Jumeirah provide additional options for swimming and water sports.

Hotels in the Al Habtoor City Dubai Area

There are three hotels in the Al Habtoor City Dubai area, including Habtoor Palace Dubai. This luxurious destination is renowned for its opulence and elegance. In addition to La Perle, guests can indulge in a myriad of impressive amenities at Habtoor Palace Dubai. For those seeking a lively evening experience, BOA Dubai awaits on the 32nd floor of the V Hotel.

The other Al Habtoor Hotel is V Hotel Dubai, Curio Collection by Hilton. Located within the Al Habtoor City complex, this trendy hotel features avant-garde design, vibrant nightlife venues, and luxurious amenities. Hilton Dubai Al Habtoor City is another upscale hotel in the area that boasts modern rooms, multiple restaurants and bars, a rooftop pool, and easy access to nearby attractions.

Attractions and Landmarks near Al Habtoor City Sheikh Zayed Road Dubai

Al Habtoor City's master plan includes a plethora of leisure activities and landmarks to explore. La Perle by Dragone, an aqua-themed theater, promises an immersive experience with its aqua stage and captivating performances. Amongst nightlife options, BOA nightclub is an excellent choice. It offers an exciting venue for parties and entertainment. Notable landmarks such as Dubai Bowling Centre and Dubai Canal add to the area's allure, while the scenic views of Dubai Canal provide a picturesque backdrop for outdoor activities like running and dhow cruises.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

Fitness and beauty enthusiasts will appreciate the amenities available within Al Habtoor City, including a fully equipped health club, outdoor pools, gardens, and luxury spas offering a range of specialized treatments. The development also features a marina promenade, sky garden, amphitheater, and dedicated play areas for children and families, ensuring there's something for everyone to enjoy. With community events like the mesmerizing performances at La Perle by Dragone, residents and visitors alike are in for an unforgettable experience in Al Habtoor City.

While Al Habtoor City offers a luxurious lifestyle and a host of amenities, there are a few things to consider. Being located in the heart of Dubai, Al Habtoor City can be bustling, which may not appeal to those seeking a more tranquil living environment.

Who developed Al Habtoor City?

Al Habtoor City was developed by the Al Habtoor Group, a leading conglomerate in the UAE with interests in various sectors including hospitality, real estate, and construction.

What residential options are available in Al Habtoor City?

Al Habtoor City offers a range of residential options including luxury apartments, penthouses, and townhouses with modern amenities and stunning views of the Dubai skyline and waterways.

What hotels are located in Al Habtoor City?

The hotels in Al Habtoor City include The St. Regis Dubai, W Dubai – Al Habtoor City, and The Westin Dubai, Al Habtoor City, all offering luxurious accommodations, dining options, and leisure facilities.

Where is Al Habtoor City located?

Al Habtoor City is centrally located in Dubai, along the picturesque Dubai Water Canal. Positioned centrally on Sheikh Zayed Road, it offers easy accessibility to many iconic landmarks and attractions scattered throughout the city.

How many rooms are there at Hilton Dubai Al Habtoor City?

Hilton Dubai Al Habtoor City Sheikh Zayed Road Dubai offers guests over 100 comfortable rooms and suites, offering glittering skyline views.

How many rooms does V Hotel Al Habtoor City have?

The luxury hotel houses 356 guestrooms and suites.

How to go to Al Habtoor City?

If you are driving,  follow Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), one of Dubai's main highways. Al Habtoor City is located on Sheikh Zayed Road, making it easily accessible by car. You can also use public transportation, as Dubai Metro's Red Line connects the area. The nearest metro station to Al Habtoor City is the Business Bay Metro Station. From there, you can take a short taxi ride or walk to your destination.

What types of properties are available in Al Habtoor City?

Al Habtoor City offers luxury apartments, hotels, and penthouses.

How is transportation in Al Habtoor City? 

Transportation is convenient with easy access to major roads, public buses, and nearby metro stations.
